messages:
Ivy Chen: hey everyone — first day as Product Designer here! quick checklist: 1) Figma access, 2) product roadmap Notion, 3) where research artifacts (recordings/transcripts) live, and 4) whos my onboarding buddy?

Bea (design-ops): welcome Ivy!! :tada: DM me your work email and Ill add you to the Product Design team in Figma and the Design group in Notion. We also have a short "Design Onboarding" Notion page with style tokens + component rules.

Ivy Chen: thanks Bea  DM sent (ivy@redwood.com). small perms Q: are designers editors by default or commenter? trying to avoid accidental overrides.

Liam Ortega: designers on the core team get editor by default. we rely on file version history and branches for the team library. if you prefer comment-only on certain files, tag me or @be a and well set per-file perms.

Priya (Research): hi Ivy, welcome! Research recordings live in the Research Drive; synths and transcripts are in Notion under Research > Artifacts. We keep a 3-doc starter pack for new hires — tell me which area youre focused on and Ill drop it.

Ivy Chen: onboarding flow + signup funnel please. Also, is there a convention for adding research notes in Figma?

Priya (Research): we use comment threads prefixed with "Research: <study-name>" and link the Notion artifact. For persistent findings we put a short summary in the Notion artifact and paste the link into the Figma file comments.

Marta (PM): roadmap is here: https://notion.redwood.com/product/roadmap. PMs own initiative pages; designers are commenter by default but we can grant edit access by initiative. If you want to join the onboarding initiative, ping me and Ill add you.

Ivy Chen: perfect — please add me to the onboarding initiative. Also curious: who runs the weekly design crits and how do I get on the calendar?

Liam Ortega: design crits are Fridays 11am PT. Ill add you to the calendar invite. If you want to present in week 1, DM me and Ill reserve a 10-min slot.

Bea (design-ops): sent Figma + Notion invites to ivy@redwood.com. also added you to the Design Onboarding page which includes component contribution flow and token-change checklist.

devex-bot: Tip: run `/request-access figma product` to create a ticket for design-ops if DM isn't convenient.

Ivy Chen: got invites, thank you! last quick one: who should I ping for a frontend pairing to get local preview/storybook running?

Marta (PM): ping #eng-frontend and ask for a "frontend buddy" — we usually do a 30m pairing to get Storybook + local preview up. I can intro you to the squad buddy after lunch.

Ivy Chen: awesome, appreciate the help everyone 60a. excited to get started and join the crits next week.
